suggest.phpmailer/phpmailer: Optional SMTP adapter for Core\Libs\Mail; supports PHPMailer 6.9 and 7.1.
suggest.boctulus/simplerest-api-clients: Optional Google Drive, WooCommerce, OneSignal, and Hugging Face API clients; currently installed from GitHub through Composer VCS.
suggest.boctulus/simplerest-web-inspection: Optional CMS and technology detection plus HTML scraping; currently installed from GitHub through Composer VCS.
suggest.guzzlehttp/guzzle: Optional HTTP client used by the bundled SendinBlue adapter.
suggest.ext-curl: Optional HTTP transport acceleration for API clients and webhook integrations.
suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: Optional PDO MySQL driver when connecting to MySQL or MariaDB.
suggest.ext-pdo_pgsql: Optional PDO PostgreSQL driver when connecting to PostgreSQL.
suggest.ext-pdo_sqlite: Optional PDO SQLite driver when connecting to SQLite.
suggest.boctulus/simplerest-fpdf: Optional PdfBase adapter powered by the FPDF library; currently installed from GitHub through Composer VCS.
suggest.boctulus/simplerest-scaffolding: Optional make commands and PHP development tools; currently installed from GitHub through Composer VCS.
suggest.boctulus/simplerest-bootstrap-html: Optional Bootstrap 5 and AdminLTE builders plus Bootstrap pagination; preserves former core class names when installed.
suggest.boctulus/llm-providers: Optional unified clients for OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, and Ollama; currently installed from GitHub through Composer VCS.
